coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of the 6 ground-truth variable items (50%): the TorchViz versus TorchOpt comparison, standard versus fused Adam implementations, and gradient graph complexity measured through node counts, edge counts, and visualization clarity.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Model architecture is varied rather than held constant. Omniglot and other standard meta-learning datasets are omitted. Although optimizer hyperparameters are fixed, training steps are varied and fixed batch size and loss configuration are not specified, so the training-configuration constant is not fully matched. TorchViz is also used to render all conditions rather than clearly treating visualization tool as a separate independent variable.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied in the designated field. The expected-outcome discussion within design_output does not substitute for the missing conclusion_output.
